logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

A single-panel horizontal bar chart titled "Verified energy per common acceptance run (kWh)". Four bars in ranked order: P2 = 12 kWh (highlighted green, labeled winner), P3 = 52 kWh, P1 = 56 kWh, P4 = 58 kWh (grey-blue). Each bar carries its quality index and raw defect count as a small side label (e.g., P2: q=97, d=1). A dashed vertical annotation marks the 40 kWh gap between P2 and P3. A footnote strip states both policy gates (quality >= 80, defects <= 5) and notes that all four candidates qualify on the same fixed-flow, fixed-head acceptance basis. Clean sans-serif, no decorative elements; every label serves the verification comparison.
